1.notes: Jungle spawn with ocean/BT seed and good nether. 300 block blind and got GP on the way to SH, ship on 32nd w/ transport for ~50min fk, midgame was slow, got all gold blocks solely from monuments, 1/39 on trident (missed thunder because of this), last biome was warm ocean, endgame was nothing special (forgot guardian lol)

2.notes: mega taiga spawn next to jungle, desert (that i couldnt find in any%) and snow. i died twice during any% and had many close deaths but nevertheless the nether wasnt as bad as i thought. fk ~1:25 and got really bad ocean+desert until later on so i had to prioritise misc which lost me a lot of time, as well as hunting creepers. skulls fort took a while to find and i made a misplay thinking that the jungle at spawn had no pandas but actually ended up having them which i did in endgame. flew around for 3 minutes trying to find ocean for dolphin during hdwgh but it was fine. missed a rain cycle during any% and only had another one but neither of which had thunder

3.notes: first 'desert' seed, had a 37gp temple but got treasured twice (+30 gold blocks lol), got mending unbreaking 3 and piercing 4 in one library killing dragon at ~40min. INSTA SHIP SPAWN, only left on two elytras lol because of the unb3 mending for ~1:04 midgame start (already had leads as there was swamp right at spawn and not to mention another bamboo! ...with only one panda). oh, my enchanting split was a minute long btw leaving with a ton of levels. got insane shell+trident luck this run and a bunch of gold blocks from monuments however desert temples were lacking in the beginning which slightly slowed the mid-midgame. got slightly rolled on mushroom (and went 3/108 on skulls), but riptide+channeling combo popped off and i started debris+endgame around ~3:19. played pretty well, not much i couldve saved time on really

4.notes: ok so literally a normal ass aa run (22min any%, 25min elytra) until early-midgame which was lacking temples and much desert/ocean, so had to frontload a lot of misc which lost me a bit of time. at around ~1:30 i had a trident and wanted to save for riptide so i decided to trade for channeling only to waste 10 minutes breaking lecterns because i later found a channeling book in a temple. besides the point the riptide was useful for mushroom. the nether itself was not enjoyable but i did get above average with skulls and a lot of monuments so it wasnt too bad. got lucky with debris only really using a stack of tnt for endgame and was on pb pace but threw hdwgh for not checking dolphins grace before splashing potions. had to rebrew which lost me 10min and the end again was also a bit stupid too as i didnt have enough blaze powder D: (didnt grab any backups for any of the resources needed) p.s. if i had hdwgh i wouldve been pacelocked by sweet dreams anyways lol

5.notes: bad spawn and nether was alright, instant ship pretty much which saved some time but accidental relog almost caused an issue with not getting looting Scared, but pulled it off last second with book enchant.. midgame felt very sloppy except for biomes (birch hills last), i had an early thunder cycle which lasted 2mins so 0 chance i was able to get vvf. nether was full of fortresses and got good luck with skulls despite the bad fort i used, quadrant checking was pretty poor due to the lack of ocean+desert i had initially so i was mainly >10k pos pos. had a mansion for easy raid which was funny, but main annoyance was weak ocean for nautilus shells (had to riptide for drowned) and getting way too many trident guys. got lucky on debris so thats cool.endgame was smooth except for not recalling the closest ocean (fault of decision making from the start of midgame), found A SECOND MANSION as I was flying the dolphin <1k from spawn

6.notes: two goofy deaths in any% ow costing me 10 mins, had to nether roof for fort 32ch+ as i got treasured (bugged pie as well), outer end was really dense with cities. midgame start was weird as i had a snowy blind and parrot on sh but good as i had enough gp to travel around to other quadrants. lost time trying to get leads slightly and ocean had a lot of monuments but not good enough ruins for all shells. initial jungle did not have bamboo hills despite being surrounded by jungle hills, skulls fort was scuffed but got lucky with rates. one vein of doom for debris. uhhh then i blinded into bamboo hills anyways 5min after the end again lol

7.notes: long overworld, spent some time killing creepers first night. buried bridge bastion had 6 stacks of pearls, extraregional fort although had to blind travel for sh which was 2k blocks out, got some extra gp on the way. outer end had minimalistic cities but juicer tools/armor which made enchanting fast. had to spend ~50mins of my midgame in temperate biomes as there wasn't a single temple, however I had pretty good nautilus shell luck and good priorities over misc (looting 3 diamond sword helped with creeper kills). had a mansion close to spawn and a GOD APPLE within the mansion too, trident = ragebait getting 10 dura (insta channeling) but 2nd trident 0 dura, which couldnt be used for riptide (below avg rates anyways). first desert temple at ~2:11, then FINALLY got a rare biome about ~2:30 in. it was very sluggish because of bad biome luck as well as lacking desert temples but one final desert i checked started cranking out which made me start endgame earlier, despite missing jungle and mesa. endgame was scuffed asf, building bee chunk loader not in spawn chunks (did debris with bees setup anyways so it wasn't that punishing), had rain during raid so i had to sit around for thunder which i didnt get before executing hdwgh. i never marked monument coords as i assumed spawn ocean had one but it didnt. killed dragon manually to keep xp levels so I could trade for mending for elytra+riptide trident. overlapped bees while trading for mending. got a very quick rain cycle while breaking lecterns so i did manage to pull off the last two biomes about 20k out (RTA was 6h+ lol)

8.notes: shipwreck+bt overworld, good any% nether proximity, sub30 elytra but had to really force outer end (thankfully had unb3 elytra). had slime at spawn, focused misc+villages due to spawn biomes, had 3 tridents early on but crap dura, got rolled on igloo for snowy and got thunder while enchanting for riptide, got super rolled on not getting channeling however vvf'ed clutched by trading channeling (7 lecterns!) with villagers (~had 5mins to spare). did brown mushroom tech! wasted a lot of time in a jungle as i got rolled on pandas losing me majority of the riptide usage. nether was dogshit but got above average rates for skulls despite forcing bad forts. last biome was mesa which was thankfully next to a jungle with pandas and plenty of temples to finish off tnt+gp. still didnt have igloo so i had an abandoned village for zillager then found a stray zillager after 8 shells to do manual zoctor. it was somewhat ~sub3:30 pace but got ragebaited by debris (literally used almost every tnt i had), forgot fermented spider eye as i used that for weakness beforehand which messed up my potion muscle memory which ended up making me choke hdwgh because i messed up brewing slowness. quick recovery however using pillager yeet and notchless hdwgh :) p.s. i had snowy right at spawn and never saw it. p.p.s. it had igloo...
